snippet.title: Prince Jackson Shares the Most Meaningful Items He Still Has from His Dad Michael Jackson ❤️
snippet.description:
Prince Jackson, son of the legendary Michael Jackson, opens up about the most meaningful items he still cherishes from his father.

In this heartfelt conversation, he talks about his dad’s model train station at Neverland Ranch, where they spent quality time together designing scenery and watching the trains run. He still keeps one of the train cars as a treasured memory.

He also shares the story of a special notebook from his film school days at home. Michael Jackson had invited a professor from UCLA or USC to teach him and his cousins filmmaking. The notebook contains film shots, framing notes, and most importantly — Michael Jackson’s own handwritten notes in red ink. Prince’s cousin Taj preserved it and later gifted it to him.

These two items hold immense emotional value for Prince as they represent the precious father-son moments he shared with the King of Pop.

🎙️ From Prince Jackson’s recent interview
Credit: KOST 103.5 FM & Ellen K Morning Show

What did Michael Jackson really tell his son Prince in the final weeks of his life? Years later, Prince Jackson described under oath the fear, pressure, and deeply personal moments he remembered from his father's final days.
This documentary examines Prince's courtroom testimony, Michael Jackson's preparations for the This Is It concerts, the intense pressure surrounding his comeback, and the family perspective behind one of the most closely examined periods of his life. We also look at what Prince later shared about his father's advice, legacy, and the lessons he continues to carry into adulthood.
Rather than relying on speculation or sensational claims, this story focuses on the public record, Prince's own testimony, and the historical context surrounding Michael Jackson's final weeks.
What did Michael Jackson's words reveal about the man behind the global superstar—and why does Prince's account still resonate with fans today?

localized.description:
#MichaelJackson #PrinceJackson #KingOfPop
What did Michael Jackson really tell his son Prince in the final weeks of his life? Years later, Prince Jackson described under oath the fear, pressure, and deeply personal moments he remembered from his father's final days.
This documentary examines Prince's courtroom testimony, Michael Jackson's preparations for the This Is It concerts, the intense pressure surrounding his comeback, and the family perspective behind one of the most closely examined periods of his life. We also look at what Prince later shared about his father's advice, legacy, and the lessons he continues to carry into adulthood.
Rather than relying on speculation or sensational claims, this story focuses on the public record, Prince's own testimony, and the historical context surrounding Michael Jackson's final weeks.
What did Michael Jackson's words reveal about the man behind the global superstar—and why does Prince's account still resonate with fans today?
Watch until the end, and share your thoughts in the comments.

snippet.title: Prince Jackson on ‘Michael’ success: ‘My father's legacy means so much to me’ | AP Interview
snippet.description:
Prince Jackson reflects on helping bring his father Michael Jackson’s story to the big screen as an executive producer of “Michael,” the biopic starring his cousin Jaafar Jackson. Speaking with Associated Press entertainment journalist Liam McEwan at the Palace Theatre in Los Angeles, where his father filmed the “Thriller” video, Prince discusses the film’s billion-dollar success, learning more about his father through the production, Jaafar’s transformation into the King of Pop and why he hopes his cousin receives awards season recognition.

Subscribe ⁨@APNewsEntertainment.

#MichaelJackson #Thriller #KingOfPop #Michael #MichaelMovie #MJ

Prince also opens up about the possibility of a sequel, the film’s critical reception and the portrayal of his grandfather, Joe Jackson. Plus, he discusses continuing his father’s philanthropic legacy through the Heal Los Angeles Foundation and its annual “This Is Thriller” event.
